description:
Lists the books the reader is reading now, from their ReadingRate library: current page, percent complete, pages left, and the hours left at their own logged reading pace. Also lists poems they have recently read again, with how many times.

Use when the user asks what they are reading, how far along they are in a book, or how long a book they are reading will take them to finish.

For books they have finished or want to read, use get_reading_history.
name: get_currently_reading

books.description: Books in progress, with progress and time estimates

book.description: Book info: id, slug, title, authors, difficulty_score, word_count, cover_url

progress.description: current_page, total_pages (printed pages of the reader's copy), percent_complete, pages_remaining; for a copy with a roman-numbered introduction also front_matter_pages and page_label (the page as printed, e.g. "liv" or "10"): current_page then counts from page i, so show page_label of total_pages, and percent_complete and pages_remaining count the whole copy

page_label.description: The page as printed, for a copy with a roman-numbered introduction

poem_count.description: Number of poems in the poems array

poems.description: Poems the reader has read again recently, most recent first. return_count is how many times each was read.

title: Get books in progress
